hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty'); case "$f" in */src/main/kotlin/*.kt) grep -q '@McpTool' "$f" && jq -n --arg f "${f##*/}" '{hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "PostToolUse", additionalContext: ($f + " has MCP tools. If this changed one (its name, title, description, hints or parameters), run `just mcp-tools` and commit the snapshot and version it writes, keeping old tools working (CLAUDE.md); McpToolsTest fails until then.")}}';; esac; exit 0
